text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A park with a pond. I caught sight of a 
figure trying to climb over its fence. 
Could that be...!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It's all over now... I might as well just 
throw myself into this pond...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Trainer! Please don't stop me! Pond 
scum is all I'm good for anyway~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"I hope you just float there, get pecked 
by fish, and have to be rescued by a 
swan!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, that's... Please... take a look at 
this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What Matikanefukukitaru showed me was a 
race review article for the Kinko Sho.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"‘Machikane Fukukitaru's performance on 
the track was utterly disgraceful.’"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"It's not a matter of race results. Her 
heart wasn't in her running at all, and it 
was simply unpleasant to watch."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"There is no pride as an athlete there, 
nor any showmanship to please the fans. 
There is nothing."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"As someone who loves racing, I cannot 
call her an Umamusume. She is..." Uuu...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Gyafun! Trainer, you didn't have to say it 
all the way to the end, you know!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
“Still... that's fine. You're completely 
right. The truth hurts... It hurts so much 
my ears might fall off.”

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I was under a misconception. I thought as 
long as luck was on my side, everything 
would be fine, and I'd be forgiven for 
anything...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Of course not, right? I got carried away 
and said something terribly rude to 
Suzuka-san, too...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Above all, how am I ever going to 
apologize to the fans...?"
choice_data_list: There's the Takarazuka Kinen, isn't there?

There's always the Takarazuka Kinen, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? You're right. Spring has only just 
begun. At the Takarazuka Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Wait, no, no, no, you can't do that, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
You're forgetting something important. The 
Takarazuka Kinen is a race chosen by fan 
voting, isn't it~?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Nobody's going to pick someone who did 
what I did. I practically threw dirt in my 
fans' faces, after all.
choice_data_list: It's too early to give up...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Even if it's just comfort, it 
makes me happy... Even though I let you 
down, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"It might be too late, but starting from 
here, I'll look for ways to make amends 
one by one..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
For now, I think I'll go feed the carp in 
the pond today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru starts throwing bread 
into the pond. The carp ate it with 
relish.
